title: The sign at night
logline: The tavern's sign lit at night, from across 101: two of its tubes dead, so the name is a name with two letters missing. The page draws the dead letters as gray glass. Reserved twice over.

panels.composition: A tavern's neon sign at night from across a highway, lit, with two of its letter-tubes dead and gray, the door below, the beer sign in a side window.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a tavern's neon sign at night seen from across a highway with two of its letter tubes dead and gray, the door below and a beer sign in a side window, lettering not legible
image.notes: Name reserved; two letters dark on top of that.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
